name: professional-thank-you
description:
Writes professional thank-you messages for interviews, meetings, referrals,
and business interactions that strengthen relationships through specific
acknowledgment and genuine appreciation. Use when the user needs to thank
someone in a professional context. Do NOT use for general professional emails
(use `professional-email`), business letters (use `business-letter`), or
meeting follow-ups that are primarily about action items (use `meeting-notes`).
